title: Patient Reported Outcomes in German Physiotherapy from patients' perspective
summary:
An online survey will be conducted as part of this study.
After patients have completed the online discharge survey about their treatment in the physiotherapy practice, they will receive an invitation to take part in a survey.
To do this, patients can click on a personalized link to an online survey.
The questions of the online survey were generated from the previous literature on the topic 'Patients - Perspective on PROMs'.
The data is collected using a system that allows the response data to be compared in an pseudonymized form with the results of the previous PROM survey of the patients.
Patients will judge statements about PROMs. They can rate between 'I don't agree at all' to 'I fully agree'.
The data will be evaluated on the one hand with regard to the degree of agreement with the previous findings on the patient perspective and on the other hand with regard to possible correlations with certain variables from the PROM surveys and demographic data.
